instruction:
Fix `plugins/catalog/src/components/CatalogEntityPage/useEntityFromUrl.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. The rename redirect re-runs after it navigates. (1) Old frontend system: CatalogEntityPage.test.tsx times out after 600s with React 'Maximum update depth exceeded' (checkForNestedUpdates -> dispatchSetState -> react-router setStateImpl/listener) pointing at the navigate(..., { replace: true, state: { formerEntityRef: stringifyEntityRef({ kind, namespace, name }) } }) call near line 78: navigate is called repeatedly. (2) New frontend system: alpha/pages.test.tsx 'Entity page > Entity Page renames > redirects an old entity URL and shows the rename notice' fails at expect(notice).toHaveTextContent(/old-name/) — Received: 'This entity was renamed from component:default/new-name'. So after the first redirect, the effect runs again with the NEW url's kind/namespace/name and navigates again with formerEntityRef set to the new ref. Fix: call the former-ref lookup only after a by-name miss for the current URL ref; capture the former ref (the URL's kind/namespace/name at lookup time) together with the lookup result; navigate exactly once per resolved result (e.g. guard with a ref keyed by the former ref), never when the resolved entity's ref equals the current URL ref, and never re-run the lookup/navigate when the URL already points at the resolved entity. Keep sub-route, search and hash; keep the loading state while the lookup runs; on a miss or when getEntityByFormerRef is absent keep today's not-found behaviour.
